'''Jiří Linhart''' (13 April 1924 &ndash; 6 January 2011)<ref name="Obituary">{{cite journal|last1 = Robson|first1 = Anthony|last2 = Knoepfel|first2 = Heinz|last3 = Reiser|first3 = Martin|title = Obituary of George Jiri Linhart|journal = [[Physics Today]]|publisher = [[American Institute of Physics]]|location = [[College Park, Maryland]]|date = 12 February 2011| issue=2 |url = https://physicstoday.scitation.org/do/10.1063/pt.4.1928/full/|doi = 10.1063/PT.4.1928|access-date = 19 November 2020|url-access = subscription}}</ref> was a [[nuclear fusion]] physicist and Czech Olympic [[Swimming (sport)|swimmer]]. He competed in the [[Swimming at the 1948 Summer Olympics – Men's 200 metre breaststroke|men's 200 metre breaststroke]] at the [[1948 Summer Olympics]] in London.<ref name="SportsRef">{{cite Sports-Reference|url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/li/jiri-linhart-1.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200418082616/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/li/jiri-linhart-1.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=18 April 2020|title=Jiří Linhart Olympic Results|accessdate=19 September 2016}}</ref> He stayed on in London{{Citation needed|date=November 2023}} after which he took his PhD under the supervision of [[Dennis Gabor|Denis Gabor]]. He was a pioneer of Nuclear Fusion, author of [https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/journal-of-fluid-mechanics/article/abs/plasma-physics-by-j-g-linhart-amsterdam-north-holland-publishing-co-1960-278-pp-50s/B5B22BC6E784AF39819CB8F40B17D112# "Plasma Physics" (1960) - the first textbook on Plasma science], and many [https://iopscience.iop.org/article/10.1088/0029-5515/10/3/001 academic papers] and early [https://www.freepatentsonline.com/3113917.html patents on nuclear reactors].

In 1956 he became group Head of Acceleration at [[CERN]], and in 1960 he became the head of the [[Euratom|EURATOM]] group in Frascati.

He was also a very keen chess player, playing in the [https://www.chessgames.com/perl/chessplayer?pid=161073 Haifa Olympiad in 1976.]
